test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Sports Minister Kiren Rijiju has launched which edition of the Fit India School Week in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2nd.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Sports Minister Kiren Rijiju has launched the second edition of Fit India School Week program in Jan 2021.
 
• To participate in the program the schools have to register themselves on www.fitindia.gov.in/fit-india-school-week.
 
• The first Fit India School week program was launched in November 2019 and saw participation from over 15 thousand schools across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Shri Kiren Rijiju, has assumed charge as Minister of Law and Justice in the presence of senior officials of the Ministry.
 
• Before taking charge as Minister of Law & Justice, Shri Rijiju was Minister of State(I/C) for Youth Affairs and Sports from **May 2019 to July 2021** and Minister of State of Minority Affairs from May 2014 to May 2019.
 
• At the age of 31, he was appointed as a Member of the Khadi and Village Industries Commission, Government of India (2002-04). In 2004 he was elected to the 14th Lok Sabha from West Arunachal Pradesh constituency.
